verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog documents that Linear Agent sets up, runs and tests code, then opens the app in the browser, navigates through a flow to verify its implementation, and captures before-and-after screenshots so visual changes can be reviewed alongside the code. This matches the story exactly, but the evidence is first-party changelog claims only. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, in-depth docs on how the browser verification and screenshots work.
